title: storefront adds @koa/router
description: A synthetic change to storefront's lockfile that adds @koa/router 10.1.1, which pulls in path-to-regexp 6.2.1. Any decision on a path-to-regexp advisory for storefront was made without this path.
tip: e.g. risk_accepted on GHSA-9wv6-86v2-598j, then deploy and watch it go stale

title: storefront ships the proxy-addr fix
description: A synthetic lockfile refresh that moves storefront from proxy-addr 2.0.7 to 2.0.8, the step the upgrade plan gives for GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h (CRITICAL). A fix_planned decision on it for storefront is confirmed by the graph once no exposure path is left; a fixed decision recorded before the deploy is disputed until then.
tip: e.g. fix_planned on GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h, then deploy and watch the graph confirm the fix
